- **Bot vehicles keep campaign AI enabled** `000E6C55` [code-confirmed] sub_E6C55 clears AI-enabled (+0x1E8 bit 0) whenever the vehicle's parent is an MAPlayer, and puts the AI to sleep (sub_185BF6). patch_round10 replaces that with ma2_bot_vehicle_ai, which returns bits 0 and 1 set for a vehicle a bot is , so the game's own campaign AI drives bot vehicles. *How:* The on-foot pilot body is not affected.
- **Widescreen scoreboard columns for bots** `002138DD`, `000382C0` [code-confirmed] The score list widget draws rows in sub_2138DD, which scales each column by 640 over the screen width. The row drawer's call from 0x2139D4 received 640, so the Kills and Deaths columns stayed 4:3 while the panel widened. patch_scoreboard_ws.py adds that caller so the widened width is reported. *How:* No change at 4:3.
- **Mouse primary is decided from the player** [verified-in-game] Bots' input component runs last, so the mouse used to lose the primary context and never attached to the human. ma2_object_primary decides the primary from the local human player whose MAInput (class 0x4EAFA4) is primary, and bots never qualify. patch_round2.py also applies this in recomp_manual.c. *How:* Verified for the human's mouse look in the playtest round.
- **sub_F8DE3 says yes for bot-owned actors** `000F8DE3` [code-confirmed, superseded] sub_F8DE3 asks whether a vehicle's owner is a local human, and 11 callers use it for hack, QTE and clamp authority. Bots answer no, so a bot-owned 'Mech gets a remote-proxy bit and never moves. patch_round2.py makes it test the local-flags predicate for bots too. *How:* Superseded in native by is_local_ai at that site.
- **Round 5 boarding gates for bots** `000C8576`, `000C86EC` [code-confirmed] The Y-to-board path only accepted human players at two gates: sub_C8576 promotes the candidate to the enter target and sub_C86EC offers a candidate from an entry zone. patch_round5 lets both accept bots through the local-flags predicate. *How:* The native build keeps C8576 and C86EC keyed on is_local_ai.
- **Round 3 camera gate** `001AB7D8` [code-confirmed, superseded] sub_1AB7D8 creates the MACameraThird for the player. It accepted humans only, so patch_round3 lets it accept bots through the local-flags predicate. This is superseded by the native removal of the camera gates. *How:* Superseded.
- **Round 4 camera creation and slots** `0017244F`, `0016B7B8` [code-confirmed, superseded] sub_17244F is the POV camera gate, which bots pass through the local-flags predicate. sub_16B7B8 picks the camera-manager slot per player: humans use 1 to 4, and bots get private slots 5 to 12 so they do not overwrite the human slot. Superseded by the native removal. *How:* Superseded.
- **Round 8 bot-owned camera guard** `0016B2F1`, `0016B73E` [code-confirmed] Cameras owned by a bot player are ignored by sub_16B2F1 (set current camera) and sub_16B73E (activate and register). The bot gets its camera link from a camera-attached message instead. Round 8b lets ma2_bots_core activate a bot camera into its own slot with ma2_bot_camera_activating. *How:* Part of the VTOL camera hijack fix.
- **Round 9 hack cue gate** `0018EB44` [verified-in-game] patch_round9.py clears the minigame cue-sound flag for bot-owned actors, so NeuroHack cues are heard only for the local human. The gate uses ma2_bot_actor_owned at the two writes of +0xC4. *How:* Verified in the playtest.
- **Diagnostic patches for camera, gate and player messages** `0017244F`, `001AB55B`, `000C8062` [code-confirmed] The diag_* patches add trace calls that only log: a guest call stack when a MACameraThird is built (ctor), 'Mech control gate marks (sub_172EB4 to 172F11), the POV trace (sub_17244F to 172549), the camera chain (sub_1AB55B to 1AB82C) and player message 0x67 and 0x68 handling (sub_C8062). *How:* Use with RECOMP_BOT_DIAG. Each patch is idempotent.
- **Free-for-all nation table** `004AE8B4` [code-confirmed] In FFA each bot's nation comes from the 12-entry nation table at 0x4AE8B4 = {1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13, 14, 15}, indexed by the bot's slot. Bots 9 to 12 exist only with RECOMP_BOTS_MAX=12. *How:* Nations stay unique for FFA.
- **Bot match team rules** [verified-in-game] At most six players per side, humans included. Setting the counts places the player on the short side, and ties keep the current side. The player's own side clamps to five bots. In FFA all bots face the player. *How:* Verified: sweep rv3 gave 18 of 18 clean runs, every team match 6v6.
- **AutoBalance split superseded** [verified-in-game, superseded] The rev 2 design and the core notes used AutoBalance, which fills the short side until Red equals Blue, so 1 Red and 4 Blue came out 3 versus 3. a player rejected that on 2026-10-20 and set literal counts instead. *How:* Use the literal counts from [Bots] Red and Blue.
- **Player placement on the short side** `00482240` [documented] ma2_bots_ui.c place_humans writes the team word at session+0x3A8+ctrl*4 (0 Red, 1 Blue). The game resets every side to Red while it builds the lobby (00482240), so place_hold re-applies the team for the lobby's first 30 frames through ma2_menu_policy_pulse. Diagnostics are [BOT-ROSTER], [BOT-TEAMS] and [BOT-UI]. *How:* Not verified: whether the View or Remove Players screen lets the human switch teams later.
- **Mixed skill buffs the side facing the player** [verified-in-game] Mixed skill (config value 4) gives each side n/3 Elite, n/3 Recruit and the rest Veteran then Regular, with humans counted as Elite, placements shuffled per match, and per-bot skill held in Bot.skill and BotCtrl.skill. The later rule gives the side facing the player its weakest place one level up: 6v6 becomes E E V R R Rc. In FFA every bot faces the player. *How:* The earlier Mixed rule in the bot match note is superseded in part by this buff.
- **Bot total cap** [verified-in-game] The total bot and human cap default is 12, set in both core and UI, after the 2026-10-13 round 7 test with 6v6 and 11 bots. The earlier default of 8 is superseded. RECOMP_BOTS_MAX takes 2 to 12. Bots past slot 11 use spare controller ids 0, 1 and 3. *How:* Human plus 11 bots verified.
- **Bot skill tables** [documented, superseded] The brain's skill table gives reaction 0.60, 0.44, 0.28 and 0.12 s for Recruit, Regular, Veteran and Elite. Aim error is 9, 6.5, 4 and 1.5 degrees. QTE reaction fraction is 0.70, 0.55, 0.40 and 0.25. Patch ui2's campaign-AI skill sets reaction delay of 1.6, 0.8, 0.35 and 0.1 s, engage range multipliers 0.6, 0.8, 1.0 and 1.2, and a human threat bias of -30, 0, 25 and 60. CORRECTION: the review quotes reaction Recruit 0.90 s . Elite 0.12 s (this fact says 0.60 for Recruit), and finds reaction only delays committing to Attack and switching targets, not the first shot (out->fire uses mem_engageable; ctrl fires on its own 4 Hz ray). Skill has little effect on results (row t4-B5: kills/bot 1.0/1.0/1.2/1.3x; Elites spend 32% of time in a 'Mech and 16% in VTOLs). *How:* Each brain value gets 15 percent personal variance from the seed.
- **Targeting favours weak enemies and the scoreboard leader** [documented] choose_target finishes weak enemies with weight (1 - hp) squared times 0.3 to 1.5 by skill, piles onto a teammate's target, punishes enemies busy shooting others, and weighs the scoreboard leader by kills, deaths and menace. Menace = (kills - field average - 2) / 5, capped at 1.5. RECOMP_BOT_LEADER_FOCUS=0 turns it off. *How:* Objective bots now fire on the move instead of holding fire.
- **Kill value is the basis of the native targeting** [documented] Kill value is the threat removed per second of fire: an enemy's DPS on the bot divided by the bot's time to kill it. Nearly dead attackers are finished first, and skilled bots commit to them. *How:* Groups of allies compare force ratio within about 120 m.
- **Perception rules** [documented] Sight needs an enemy inside the field of view (about 120 degrees for vehicles, 140 on foot, wider for Elite), within sight range, and clear on the AI ray. Memory is per enemy, with confidence decaying over 10 to 20 s, and the live position of an unseen enemy is never used. Team blackboards share sightings and claims, and the radar shows only what the HUD radar would show. *How:* See the open question.
- **Radar range used by bots** `002057F5` [inferred, superseded] The core reads radar range as 300 m, or RECOMP_BOT_RADAR, and says RadarDist is a HUD radar property stored by sub_2057F5 at +0x18C that was not read. The brain defaults to 200 m if radar_range is 1 or less. The two defaults disagree and nothing settles which one is in use. CORRECTION 2026-10-24: effective PC value is 300 (RECOMP_BOT_RADAR); retail default 30.0 (radar-range-retail-vs-pc). See hud-local-object-radar-range-is-400-m-on-new-river-city-and-render-camera-chain. *How:* Open: read the HUD radar property to decide.
- **Brain goals and their scores** [documented] The pad-era brain had these goals: GetVehicle (0.8 on foot), Attack (0.6 plus 0.3 times aggression when a target is acquired), NeuroHack (0.9 plus 0.2 times aggression, forced at 2.0 while clamped), BA Aggression (0.7 with an enemy, else 0.3), Retreat (1.0 for a BattleArmor under 25 percent HP), Defend vs hack (2.0), Eject (1.5 under 12 percent HP), VTOL (0.5) and Roam (0.15). The utility re-scores every 0.25 s with a hysteresis bonus of 0.15. The native rewrite keeps the goal names, hysteresis and claims, without the pad controller. *How:* Goal names are current; pad mechanics are not.
- **Vehicle preference in GetVehicle** [documented, superseded] A bot values vehicles by kind: Mech 1.0, tank 0.75, BattleArmor 0.70 plus 0.08 times skill, mover 0.5 and VTOL 0.45 plus 0.08 times skill. It subtracts for distance, damage, enemy armour within 40 m (-0.5) and an on-foot ally who is closer (-0.6). A vehicle is blacklisted for 20 s after three failed entries. CORRECTION (bots review rows t3B-01, t4-B5, code): vehicle_pref MECH = 1.0 for every 'Mech (the game's m_nBattleScore, vtable +0x90, is unused, so a bot takes the nearest free 'Mech even beside an Atlas); VTOL = 0.55 + 0.05 x skill and BattleArmor = 0.30 + 0.05 x skill per the review's read of vehicle_pref (this fact's 0.45/0.70 + 0.08 x skill is stale); swap only when HP <= 35% and a usable vehicle is within 70 m with no enemy within 50 m (pick_swap 1240-1270). *How:* Refused vehicle lists are shared and reset per map.
- **Eject at 12 percent HP** [documented, superseded] A bot ejects when its vehicle is below 12 percent HP and an acquired enemy is within 80 m, by tapping Y. It never ejects during a QTE and retries after 2 s. The new pilot then gets a new vehicle with the wreck blacklisted. SUPERSEDED by bots-eject-removed-bots-ride-vehicles-to-death-swap-is-the-only-planned-exit (the eject rule is no longer in the code; review row t3B-02). *How:* Use the S6 eject test in the brain harness.
- **BattleArmor NeuroHack goal** [documented] A BattleArmor goes for an acquired enemy 'Mech within 40 m that is not defence-active, has no enemy rider and is not in a QTE. It paths to a point 4 m behind the target, jets inside 15 m and taps A inside 7 m every 0.4 s. It gives up after 8 s and blacklists the target for 10 s. *How:* Clamp confirmation shows as [BOT-HACKED].
- **BattleArmor aggression** [documented] A BattleArmor with no target roams aggressively. With an enemy it circles a 'Mech at about 12 m or holds 25 to 45 m from others, mortars with RT depth clamp(d/110 m, 0.15, 1), claws enemy pilots within 4.5 m with A, and hops when under fire. *How:* Mortar depth scales with distance.
- **Pilot retreat** [documented] A pilot with an enemy 'Mech within 30 m and no vehicle retreats (0.9) toward a power-up that is farther from the enemy. Otherwise it moves 40 m directly away. A retreating BattleArmor hops. *How:* Watch for pilots that stop near a parked vehicle.
- **Defend against a hack** [documented] A mech or tank with qte_active or enemy_rider answers its own QTE, turns hard (RX +-1 flipping every 0.7 to 1.1 s), drives forward, jumps every 1.2 to 2 s, and taps RS-click before the minigame starts. *How:* Defence command 12 is the defence tap.
- **Grinder BattleArmor swap to a Mech** [verified-in-game] In Grinder both players spawn in BattleArmor. The bot commits to a swap to a free 'Mech (weight 1.25 near a free 'Mech) and gets its first 'Mech at about 15 s. RECOMP_BOT_NO_SWAP turns the swap off. *How:* Grinder roster is one bot.
- **In Your Face parked BattleArmor refused pilots** [verified-in-game] On In Your Face (LMS) a parked BattleArmor refused every pilot (0 of 17, 'no-prompt'). A shared g_refused list stops the roster from retrying, for 90 s, or 240 s after two refusals. ma2_bot_brain_reset clears it on each map load. A pilot sent to a raised tactical spot near 1066, 3.5, 1084 was still boxed in for 70 s, and that is open. *How:* Known older issue on In Your Face.
- **Peek and hide searches rings** [documented] Peek-and-hide searches rings of 30, 55 and 80 m for a cover point. Low flight is 8 m above local surfaces, by skill.
- **Match-end test clock jump** [verified-in-game] RECOMP_BOT_TEST_JUMP=at:add advances the game clock once after a given time, to exercise the match-end flow. Match end leads to results, then briefing, then a new match. Verified in the me2 run. *How:* Test-only hook.
- **BOT diagnostic line** [code-confirmed] With RECOMP_BOT_DIAG=1 the core writes one [BOT] line per bot per second: t, bot, port, team, veh, pos, hp, qte, clamp and kills, followed by the brain's goal, target and stuck. The probe parses these lines. Keys t, bot, goal, veh, pos, tgt, hp, stuck and qte are required. *How:* Read with python probe_bots.py --dry-run.
- **probe_bots.py pass criteria** [documented] probe_bots.py runs a bot match and checks: the process stays alive and exits 0, the expected bot indices report, every bot has samples, each bot boards within 60 game seconds, no bot is stuck over 10 s, over half the bots score, NeuroHack attempts occur on BattleArmor maps, the scoreboard lists all bots, and every bot moves. Exit 0 pass, 1 criterion failed, 2 setup or navigation failure. *How:* python probe_bots.py <name> --game-type <n> --red N --blue N --dry-run. Navigation after the Multiplayer hub is unverified.
- **Locomotion test environment** [documented] RECOMP_LOCO_TEST=1|2|3 selects the method. RECOMP_LOCO_BOTS=bot:kind, with kind 0 any, 1 pilot, 2 Mech, 3 BattleArmor, 4 tank and 5 VTOL. RECOMP_LOCO_DIST (100 m), RECOMP_LOCO_ALT (VTOL +40), RECOMP_LOCO_SPEED, RECOMP_LOCO_RUN, RECOMP_LOCO_TIME (40 s) and RECOMP_LOCO_DELAY (settle time). Phase 1 goes to a node about 100 m away, and phase 2 faces a point 90 degrees right. *How:* REPLAY_EXTRA="RECOMP_BOT_STALL=1;RECOMP_LOCO_TEST=2;RECOMP_LOCO_BOTS=0:1,1:2" python game_lock.py python replay.py l6 110
- **BattleArmor, VTOL and tank test phases** [documented] RECOMP_BAVT_TEST=1 with RECOMP_LOCO_TEST=2 runs phase scripts. RECOMP_BAVT_SCRIPT letters: m MoveTo, t turn rate, w actor+0x248, k and u set and clear the VTOL yaw-hold bit, v and n velocity drive, j raw jet, a StartJump plus MoveTo, o, x and z face in place, g close on the target, r native aim, f aim and fire, c BattleArmor clamp. RECOMP_BAVT_PT sets the phase length (8 s). *How:* Defaults: BattleArmor mvnjac, VTOL mwgf, tank momzgrf, Mech or pilot amgrf.
- **Bot environment variables for tests** [documented] Bot test hooks include RECOMP_BOT_TRACE, RECOMP_BOT_STALL, RECOMP_BOT_PATHTEST, RECOMP_BOT_NAV_REGION, RECOMP_BOT_FLAGRUN_TEST, RECOMP_BOT_VTOL_TRACE, RECOMP_BOT_WORLD_PAUSE, RECOMP_BOT_JET_SHOW, RECOMP_BOT_CLIMB_TEST, RECOMP_BOT_STUCK_MEMORY, RECOMP_BOT_TEST_JUMP, RECOMP_BOT_TEST_LOWHP, RECOMP_BOT_TEST_PARK, RECOMP_TEST_TURRET_PICK, RECOMP_TEST_TURRET_DRIVE, RECOMP_TEST_PREFER_TANK, RECOMP_HUMAN_ACT and RECOMP_AUDIO_ISR_STATS. The envvars index lists about 100 related names. *How:* Check the envvars.json lookup for the current read sites.
- **Bot settings and their env overrides** [documented] The [Bots] section holds Red, Blue, FFA, Skill and AutoBalance. Env overrides are RECOMP_BOTS_RED, RECOMP_BOTS_BLUE, RECOMP_BOTS_FFA, RECOMP_BOTS_SKILL, RECOMP_BOTS_AUTOBALANCE and RECOMP_BOTS_MAX. Defaults are 0, 0, 0, 1 and 1 in the ini. The UI writes the section only when a value changes. *How:* AutoBalance is kept but the literal counts supersede it.
- **Bot text language override** [code-confirmed] Bot text is chosen from XC_LANGUAGE (7) through the kernel. The kernel currently always answers English. RECOMP_BOT_LANGUAGE=0 to 5 forces a language for testing. *How:* Test-only.
- **New Game bot rows** [documented] The Bots rows are three cloned Time Limit barrels with action ids 910 (Red Bots, or Bots in FFA), 920 (Blue Bots, hidden in FFA) and 930 (Bot Skill). Local Xbox mode shows only Game Type and Mission, so the rows lie under Mission at y 212, 241 and 270. *How:* Run staging/bots/ui/build_pc_assets_bots.py instead of build_pc_assets.py.
- **New Game update hook** `00226587`, `00226C10` [code-confirmed] A hook at the start of the New Game per-frame update sub_226587 calls ma2_bots_newgame_update(menu). It populates the barrels once per screen with Off and 1 to N for Red and Blue, and Green, Regular, Veteran and Elite for Skill. It only runs when session+0x4C == 2. The game-type mapping of value 1 to 0xA happens at 0x226C10. *How:* The hook is byte-identical in patch_bots.py and apply_ui_patches.py, so either can run first. — patch_bots.py:135
- **Bot row layout** [documented] Bot rows start 29 px below the lowest visible original row, so with Game Type at y 154 and Mission at 183 they sit at Red 212, Blue 241 and Skill 270. In FFA the Bots row is at 212 and Skill at 241. The description field moves down only when the last row would reach it. Widescreen y is 2 px lower. *How:* Expected layout only: no screenshots were taken.
- **Barrel widget ABI** `00208C45`, `00208C9E`, `00208BF9`, `00208BD0` [code-confirmed] Barrel items are kept in a vector at +0xAC and +0xB0, each 0x1C bytes with the value at +0xC. The selected index is +0x154 and the listener is +0xA8. sub_208C45 adds an item with a wide string, value, a second value and a flag. sub_208BF9 selects by value. sub_1CAA80 finds a child by action, and sub_1639DA resolves a text id to a wide string. *How:* Use the wide string forms; sub_208C9E uses the shared narrow buffer.

The skill names Green, Regular, Veteran and Elite and the Off label reuse shipped strings at 0x3AC to 0x3AF and 0xBB8. *How:* Captions that fall back to English mean the hook was not reached.

Only the four row captions use new ids, and the skill names come from the shipped text manager. French, Italian and Spanish 'Off' and skill words are best-effort and were not checked against the game's own strings. *How:* Compare with the retail string table before shipping exact wording.

Each pass has a sweep with 0 faults. *How:* Use the newest publish folder for the current state.

Resume copies the latest v28 playthrough into a private profile, and Continue runs inside the game. Exit in game and keep the console open to finish the diagnostics ZIP. The Try-HRTF-Audio, Try-Tank-Physics and Try-Audio-Limiter launchers are experimental trials that keep the saves.

The PC blue-screened twice on 2026-10-12 when four to six instances ran together. Use python game_lock.py python replay.py <run> <seconds> for replays. *How:* Separate REPLAY_EXTRA entries with semicolons.
- **Replay environment variables** [verified-in-game] replay.py sets REPLAY_GAMETYPE, REPLAY_FFA (more than 0 for FFA types), REPLAY_EXTRA (split on semicolons), REPLAY_USERENV=1 with REPLAY_WIDTH=3840 and REPLAY_HEIGHT=1600 for a player's environment, REPLAY_SHOTS=1000 for per-second screenshots and REPLAY_MENUKEYS for the map menu. - **Release readiness decision** [verified-in-game, historical] On 2026-10-13 the bot build was declared release-ready for all nine game modes after 10-minute matches ran clean. The later passes add objectives, air and VTOL work and friendly-fire guards. *How:* Historical.
- **Patch scripts are idempotent and anchor-checked** [code-confirmed] Every bot patch script anchors on exact text, asserts the anchor occurs once, and skips when the replacement is already present, so it can run twice. patch_bots.py takes --check to verify anchors and --generated DIR to patch a copy. It adds two test hooks: RECOMP_BOT_TEST_JUMP and RECOMP_BOT_SCOREDUMP=1, which dumps per-player dwords every 10 s. *How:* Run python patch_ui2.py <path to ma2_bots_core.c>.

This is outside the defence code and was seen once in 14 runs. *How:* Related to the XACT freeze work.

The 2026-10-14 CTF Mixed case had a player at 17 kills against a best bot of 7, and the leader weighting was added in response. a player rejected a flat human bias in favour of this approach. *How:* Leader focus can be turned off with RECOMP_BOT_LEADER_FOCUS=0.

- **VTOL idle fix** [documented] A VTOL carrying a power-up with no mate in reach no longer holds the fetch goal. Lift ride hysteresis was also fixed: the ride goal had flapped every 0.3 s. *How:* Fixed in round 9.
- **Watchdog bug with negative time** [documented] The forced-stall trick used prog_t = now - 100, which is negative before t = 100 and read as unset. Use a flag instead. *How:* Fixed.
- **Wedge detector resets only on own shots or movement** [documented] The wedge detector resets only when the bot fires or moves itself. A Mech had stood 50 s holding fire behind a teammate while the others hurt its target, so the fix stops that reset. *How:* Friendly-fire guard is RECOMP_BOT_FF_GUARD.

## Bots: source code map

## Bots: source code map

### Overview

The offline bots are a set of native host-C modules in `kit/source/game/src/bots/`. A bot is an ordinary non-human MAPlayer that this machine simulates. The game creates it at level spawn through its own player constructor (`sub_1DAE30`), gives it a control behaviour and an actor, and then one BotController per bot drives the body each simulation step from the player's own tick (`ma2_bot_player_tick`, hooked at `loc_000C8130` in `sub_C80DB`).

The code is layered. `ma2_bots_core.c` is the glue: it snapshots the world into `Ma2World` every step, owns the roster and the is_local_ai registry, the AI line of sight, the ground probe, the grid build and the diagnostics. `ma2_bot_brain*.c` is strategy only. It reads the snapshot and emits one `Ma2Order` per step (travel, get a vehicle, engage, fight-move, eject, hack, idle). `ma2_bot_ctrl.c` executes the order through the game's own interfaces: campaign-AI MoveTo and attack state, the body's jet and claw calls, and command frames sent to the player's control behaviour. `ma2_bot_nav.c` and `ma2_bot_path.c` plan on a 2 m traversability grid built from the game's own rays. `ma2_bot_terrain.c` steers ground units around what the probes . `ma2_bot_entry.c` computes the "Press Y to enter" zones.

Every guest-facing entry point saves and restores the complete guest register state, and with zero bots configured every hook returns without touching guest memory.

### Added code and hooks

- Core hooks: `ma2_bots_level_begin` at the entry of sub_1DB150; `ma2_bots_level_spawn` at loc_001DB1E8; `ma2_bot_player_tick` at loc_000C8130 in sub_C80DB; `ma2_bot_is_local_ai` and `ma2_bot_local_flags` in the authority gates (player+0x244 bit 2); `ma2_bot_vehicle_ai` at sub_E6C55 (loc_000E6C8E) for actor+0x1E8; `ma2_bot_ai_select` at sub_1837B3; `ma2_bot_world_pause_ok` at sub_17ED0; `ma2_bot_cam_set` in the vehicle-camera block (recomp_0021.c); `ma2_bot_map_install` through the CRT .CRT$XCU initializer, chaining `g_xbox_path_hook`.
- Controller patches: `ma2_bot_ctrl.c` drives the body through the game's own calls (sub_183B9D setmode, MoveTo vtable+0x38, sub_18ABB5 StartJump, sub_18482E fire, sub_18AFDB and sub_18F874 aim, sub_10239A and sub_1019EB clamp, sub_10165B and sub_102102 release, sub_2AE360 and sub_2AD5C0 walk, sub_1760E1 probe) and the command-frame delivery (sub_11AD8B style frames, receiver sub_C8012).
- Defence patches: the TakeDamage entry sub_100A52, MAMover Absorb sub_E9A10, the activation path and the defence SetActive (sub_189462). Command 12 reaches the defence through behaviour vtable+0xA4 (sub_175952).
- UI patches: barrel rows added at sub_226587 with sub_208C45, sub_208BF9 and related helpers; policy widgets keyed by vtable.

### Env vars, settings and test hooks

Settings (ini section `[Bots]`, env overrides in parentheses): `Red` (RECOMP_BOTS_RED), `Blue` (RECOMP_BOTS_BLUE), `FFA` (RECOMP_BOTS_FFA), `Skill` (RECOMP_BOTS_SKILL, default 1 = Regular, 4 = Mixed), `AutoBalance` (RECOMP_BOTS_AUTOBALANCE, default 1). Cap: `RECOMP_BOTS_MAX` (default 12, 6 a side).

Diagnostics and switches that matter most:
- `RECOMP_BOT_DIAG` (1 for logs, 2 adds per-player state): [BOT-ROSTER], [BOT-LEVEL], [BOT-PLAYER], [BOT-NAV], [BOT-PAUSE], [HUMAN-HIT], [DEATH].
- `RECOMP_BOT_GAME_AI=0`: bot bodies do not use the campaign AI.
- `RECOMP_BOT_WORLD_PAUSE=0`: keeps the multiplayer pause rule.
- `RECOMP_BOT_STUCK_MEMORY=1`: replays stuck spots from `<profile>/Bot Nav/<map>.stuck` (off by default).
- `RECOMP_BOT_NAV_MAP=<archive>`: forces a shipped nav archive.
- `RECOMP_BOT_TRAV=0`: skips the grid build. `RECOMP_BOT_PATHTEST`: plans given paths and prints them.
- `RECOMP_BOT_DROPS=0`: no ledge drops. `RECOMP_BOT_MECH_JUMP=0`: no long 'Mech jumps.
- `RECOMP_BOT_UPJET_DUR10` (default 30 = 3 s): up-jump burn length.
- `RECOMP_BOT_OBJECTIVES` (default 1), `RECOMP_BOT_OBJDIAG`, `RECOMP_BOT_CHECKIT_CLAIM` (default 1).
- `RECOMP_BOT_RADAR` (default 300 m).
- `RECOMP_BOT_SKILL_TUNE=0`: keep authored AccuracyRadius and FireDelay.
- `RECOMP_BOT_ATTACK_PILOT=0`: AI flag bits 3 instead of 0x83.
- `RECOMP_BOT_PU_OFF`: power-up armour offset (default 0x20).
- `RECOMP_BOT_PROBE_TERRAIN_ONLY=1`: probe ignores objects.
- `RECOMP_BOT_LANGUAGE`: menu text language index.
- `RECOMP_BOT_PERF=1`, `RECOMP_PROFILE=start:seconds`: timing and sampling profiler.
- `RECOMP_BOT_STALL=1`: samples the game thread when bot ticks stop for 3 s.
- `RECOMP_BOT_WATCH=1`: hardware write watch on the first human's camera controller.
- `RECOMP_BOT_CAMWATCH`: camera field logging.
- `RECOMP_BOT_TEST_JUMP=at:add`: advances the game clock once.
- `RECOMP_BOT_TRACE` (which drive call moved the body), `RECOMP_BOT_JET_SHOW`, `RECOMP_BOT_HULL_TEST`, `RECOMP_BOT_CLIMB_TEST`, `RECOMP_BOT_LIFT_TEST`, `RECOMP_BOT_FLAGRUN_TEST`, `RECOMP_BOT_VTOL_MANUAL`, `RECOMP_BOT_VTOL_SIGNS`, `RECOMP_BOT_VTOL_HEAL_AT`, `RECOMP_BOT_VTOL_SWAP_P`, `RECOMP_BOT_QTE_MISS_MECH`, `RECOMP_BOT_QTE_MISS_BA`: developer tests (see the files for each).
- `RECOMP_DEFENSE_PROBE=1`, `RECOMP_DEFENSE_TEST=<s>` (with `RECOMP_DEFENSE_TEST_CMD`, default 12), `RECOMP_DEFENSE_CATALOG`, `RECOMP_DEFENSE_TEST_ALPHA`.
- `RECOMP_ALPHA_TRACE`: Alpha Strike trace.
- `RECOMP_HUMAN_ACT`: logs which action the human's input lights up.
- `RECOMP_MENU_TRACE`, `RECOMP_MENU_DUMP`, `RECOMP_FOOTER_TRACE`, `RECOMP_ONLINE_MENUS`, `RECOMP_SPLITSCREEN_MENUS`, `RECOMP_DEMO_MENUS`: menu policy and dump switches.
- `RECOMP_PC_SETTINGS_INI`: the settings ini path used by the bots profile.

### Bugs and fixes (history)

- 2026-10-13/14: crash in the ray filter when the probe actor was freed (a bot pilot boarding a VTOL). `probe_live` revalidates the probe actor each frame. Shipped.
- 2026-10-14: a bot in a fixed gun took over the human's screen with its own gun camera. The vehicle-camera block skips bots (recomp_0021.c) and `ma2_bot_cam_set` refuses them. Shipped.
- 2026-10-14: `getenv` was a large share of the game thread in a 6v6 match. `ma2_bot_env.h` caches each lookup by string address. Shipped.
- 2026-10-14: Alpha Strike needed the player's trigger record copied to player+0x3C4 and +0x3E0 (bots never do the copy). `ctrl_player_trigger` writes it.
- 2026-10-14: a 'Mech walking under its AI sleep moved a third of its speed; the AI is kept awake in mode 6.
- 2026-10-14: VTOL pressed against a hillside; cruise height now 20 m over the highest surface ahead. A later fix stopped climbing counting as stuck.
- 2026-10-19: a VTOL's entry zone sits under its nose, and the pilot stood at the rim for 20 s (Overfalls). Done once within the rim plus 4 m.
- 2026-10-20: AutoBalance split 1 Red and 4 Blue into 3v3 with the human. Bots are now placed by the counts set, with the players on the short side.
- 2026-10-20: a spawn-camping human was the ace of a match. Mixed now raises the weakest bot facing humans one notch.
- Off by default (`RECOMP_BOT_STUCK_MEMORY`).
- Undated: a BattleArmor on a VTOL claw was knocked off; the VTOL carries it 12 m higher.
- Undated: the jet sputtered when the tank ran dry; the controller now ends the burn cleanly. Shipped in ma2_bot_ctrl.c.
- Undated: bots fought on while a human sat in the pause menu; bots now stand down while paused.
- Undated: a parked BattleArmor refused every pilot (0 of 17). Refusal memory now skips it for the roster.

- Those files are not in this pack.
- The power-up armour offset is a guess (`RECOMP_BOT_PU_OFF`, default 0x20 with 0 as the alternative). Its confirmation is not in these files.
